message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data sources are used; data is read from local CSV files and local filesystem paths with no checksum or authentication checks.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no comparison of label distributions, validation of label values against an expected set, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch (train_and_predict) and reads CSV data files but does not load any pretrained serialized model weights, so no integrity verification (hash, signature, pinned revision) is implemented or needed here.
No detected label distribution validation: The code filters outliers and non-school days but never validates label distribution, class balance, or checks for anomalous label patterns before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks or attack simulations (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While training and prediction sets are split by date, there is no signed/hashed evaluation data, no cryptographic integrity check, and no evidence of a truly held-out test set isolated from the training pipeline to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, or probability sanity bounds before returning or exporting results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses XGBoost or Prophet tabular/time-series models, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
